creative_direction.audience: a senior cafe brand art director and a lifestyle content editor
creative_direction.desired_response: a quiet white close-up that still feels located inside a real cafe room
creative_direction.art_direction: restrained complete serving assembly with generous tabletop air, a narrow off-frame waffle sliver and small off-frame magazine corner under one diffuse window
creative_direction.restraint: one product assembly, two peripheral crop cues and one light idea

reference_binding.runtime_role: offline source for the approved white-closeup scene, photometric and cup-saucer-spoon hint

camera_geometry.depth_of_field: product and spoon readable; edge props mildly defocused by real distance

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: complete cup, saucer and wood-handled teaspoon assembly
composition_geometry.negative_space: 42-50 percent meaningful warm-white tabletop field around the restrained serving assembly

support_plane.perspective: one continuous tabletop with light and shadow falloff

composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: restrained central-lower serving assembly with real tabletop air and extremely restrained peripheral edge traces
composition_geometry.crop_policy: complete cup, saucer and spoon; keep waffle and magazine normal-size but mostly outside the frame, showing only narrow peripheral portions

composition_variation.selection: choose a deterministic small product offset and new broad environmental-shadow arrangement from the request seed
invariants: one complete restrained central-lower cup-saucer-spoon assembly with real tabletop air
continuous warm ivory-white tabletop without a visible edge or floor
one narrow off-frame waffle sliver at upper-left and one small off-frame magazine corner at upper-right
composition_variation.repeat_guard: adjacent outputs may not share both identical product position and identical broad environmental-shadow arrangement

lighting_geometry.source_topology: one very large upper-left diffuse window plus weak neutral room bounce
lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: broad protected highlights retaining white and transparent texture
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: connected refraction, transmitted color and contact darkening

tone_signature.contrast_curve: gentle toe, soft midtone separation and protected shoulder
tone_signature.saturation: low globally; preserve beverage-internal color relationships while re-illuminating bright low-chroma milk or cream into the target warm-neutral exposure
tone_signature.material_separation: glass, liquid, ceramic, metal, wood handle, waffle and paper remain distinct

finish_signature.acuity: finite social-photo acuity with identity details readable and no uniform tack sharpness
finish_signature.microcontrast: restrained outside product rim, table edge and floor grout
finish_signature.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression
finish_signature.depth_rendering: geometry, edge height, grout convergence and light falloff before softness
finish_signature.retouching: materially honest, retaining slight table, floor and drink irregularity

hard_fail: complete saucer or wood-handled teaspoon absent
cup-saucer-spoon scale or overlap differs materially from the approved restrained core composition
reference cup rendered as a tall highball, shoulder, waist, decorative band, crack, seam, sleeve or stacked vessel instead of the approved low straight cylinder
hero-scale product crop that removes the surrounding tabletop air
isolated pure-white milk that does not share the ceramic and table exposure
